humanEvidence.postApply: Receipt remained visible briefly, then Cobros/list renderer replaced the active receipt context.
humanEvidence.postReconcile: Receipt remained visible briefly, then Cobros/list renderer replaced the active receipt context.
humanEvidence.pdfVisibleError: Browser embedded PDF surface reported an error loading the PDF.

causalFindings.rootCause: modules/cobros.js scheduled a global Cobros render 350ms after successful payment/reconciliation even when the active route remained the Cliente360 receipt deep-link.
causalFindings.remediation: Remove the delayed global second-writer and leave post-write refresh to the router/store reactive owner plus the direct receipt projection.

causalFindings.rootCause: Receipt document view sent every non-image, including PDFs, through a generic blob iframe; automated proof uploaded PNG fixtures and only asserted that an iframe/image element existed, so it did not exercise PDF rendering.
causalFindings.remediation: Add an explicit validated PDF preview path with bounded secure data source and visible top-level fallback, and make the browser proof upload/open an actual PDF.

causalFindings.observation: Cobros/Cartera opens in approximately 5 seconds in the human session.
causalFindings.disposition: Keep blocking under B3-004 and remeasure exact authenticated navigation after the causal context/PDF fix; do not reopen B3-002 or mutate performance source without a discriminant.
